messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected: spike in p99 latency on inference path (streaming endpoints). Auto-page fired at 14:12 UTC. Triage channel opened. :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: seeing p95 ~420ms -> p99 ~2.1s for /v1/stream responses starting ~14:09 UTC. Clients report stalls, partial chunks then long pauses.

bob_sre: confirmed, Grafana dashboards show control-plane configfetch latency jump and auth DB RPS spike. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/inf-path

carlos_runtime: streaming proxies showing `write timeout` backpressure to model workers around 14:08. KV cache hit ratio dropped from 82% -> 28%.

dana_ml: this aligns with a sudden increase of long-context prompts (seq len 4096) from a small cohort of customers — raises pressure on KV shards.

eva_product: support is getting tickets: customers A, B reporting streaming stalls and UI freezing. ETA on customer-facing notice?

frank_support: small batch of enterprise customers impacted (~0.6% of traffic), prioritized. I have the customer list and I'm drafting an incident banner.

bob_sre: quick customer-impact summary: 0.6% requests, p95 regressions for all streaming routes, error rate stable but timeouts up.

alice_oncall: root-cause candidates: auth token store rate-limit (throttling), config fetch spikes (feature-flag refresh), KV-cache degradation. Need to confirm order.

carlos_runtime: running `curl -s https://controlplane.internal/flags | jq '.service.inference'` shows delayed responses (700ms+) from controlplane. `strace` on proxy shows connection pool saturation to controlplane.

bob_sre: I can spin a read-replica for token-store to remove auth pressure. Doing `./runplaybook scale-token-db --replicas=2` now.

incident-bot: playbook job started by bob_sre (job id job-8732).

alice_oncall: mitigation steps in parallel: 1) enable local TTL for feature flag cache to avoid full controlplane calls (grace_platform?). 2) scale token-store read capacity (bob_sre). 3) temporarily route streaming traffic to low-memory model variant with smaller KV usage (carlos_runtime). 4) notify customers (frank_support / eva_product).

grace_platform: toggling local flag cache to 30s TTL for inference proxies now (`PATCH /agents/config`) — pushing to canary nodes first.

carlos_runtime: canary applied to 10% of proxies. Observed immediate reduction in controlplane calls from those proxies.

bob_sre: token-db replica provisioned, follow-up to warm connection pools. Latency on token GETs down from 320ms -> 45ms on replica.

dana_ml: suggest model fallback config: `model_variant: compact-kv` for streaming routes for next 15m. Carlos, can you apply?

carlos_runtime: applied fallback for streaming route `stream-v1` to `compact-kv` on all gateways. Starting rollout now.

alice_oncall: early signals: p99 for streaming routes dropped from 2.1s -> 860ms in canary, and overall p95 back to ~350ms. KV hit ratio slowly recovering.

frank_support: posting customer banner now: "We are investigating intermittent streaming stalls; some customers may see increased latency. Mitigation in progress."

eva_product: thanks. Flagging account escalation list and offering hourly updates to affected customers.

bob_sre: follow-up: controlplane logs show a recent feature-flag push at 14:06 that caused clients to revalidate feature gating en masse (internal rollout 10% -> 100% automated). Looks like a buggy rollout script hammered config endpoints.

alice_oncall: can we pin the rollout or rollback?

grace_platform: rollback staged: aborting rollout to remaining clusters, leaving canaries at 10% paused. Pushed `featureflag.rollout.abort` at 14:28 UTC.

dana_ml: confirm that model-serving config is stable on canaries. None of the model workers errored out.

carlos_runtime: yes, workers fine. Still watching KV cache warm-up.

alice_oncall: next actions: 1) keep token-db replica and monitor RPS. 2) keep featureflag rollout paused and audit rollout script. 3) maintain model fallback for 20m, then assess re-route back. 4) collect traces for 14:04-14:20 window and attach to postmortem.

bob_sre: adding alert to reduce blast radius for future rollout: rate-limit rollout calls to controlplane to 50r/s per region and add jitter.

incident-bot: on-call handoff scheduled — alice_oncall handing to bob_sre at 15:00 UTC for extended monitoring. Use `#oncall-handoff` for notes.

alice_oncall: handing off now. Leaving runbook notes: `scaled token-store replica`, `local flag TTL 30s canary`, `model fallback applied`, `featureflag rollout aborted`.

bob_sre: taking over monitoring. I'll keep logs open and check for regression. If p99 >1.2s re-escalate to infra lead.

frank_support: customer update posted at 14:35 UTC with affected list and mitigation steps. Will send targeted DM to enterprise contacts.

eva_product: preparing postmortem outline and customer-facing FAQ. We'll include runbook changes and mitigation options (fallback model, per-customer rate limits).

alice_oncall: quick retrospective notes in thread: likely root cause chain = feature-flag rollout flood -> controlplane overload -> token-store proxy/backpressure -> KV cache misses -> streaming tail latency.

bob_sre: closing live mitigation: p99 stabilized ~720ms, traffic at 100% normal with fallbacks. Leaving monitoring candles on for 1h.

incident-bot: INCIDENT update: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: S3 (customer impact limited, partial stalls). Postmortem owner: eva_product. Deadline for draft: 48h.

frank_support: I'll follow up with customers and offer logs.

alice_oncall: handing off completely. thanks team. :raised_hands:
